user.title: Choose authentication method
user.description: The in-fridge camera feed only works with Samsung Account login. The Personal Access Token (PAT) path is legacy — Samsung now expires new PATs every 24 hours and PATs cannot read the camera endpoint.

menu_options.pat: Personal Access Token (legacy, no camera, 24h expiry)

samsung_account.title: Samsung Account login
samsung_account.description:
Sign in with the Samsung Account that owns the fridge. The integration re-authenticates automatically on every 401 — no manual token rotation.

⚠ Accounts with 2FA/MFA enabled are NOT supported by the underlying library. Disable 2FA on this account (or use a dedicated sub-account without 2FA).

The two advanced fields (signin_client_id / signin_client_secret) are pre-filled with values extracted from the SmartThings Android APK (1.8.45.24). Leave them as-is unless Samsung rolls a new version with different credentials.

pat.title: SmartThings Personal Access Token
pat.description: Tokens created after 2024-12-30 expire every 24 hours. You will need to reauthenticate after each expiry. This mode does NOT enable the camera feed — use Samsung Account login for that.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SmartThings
reauth_confirm.description: Your SmartThings token has expired. Please enter a new token from https://account.smartthings.com/tokens
